brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.requirement: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: Four full bases placed in a line at 0,0 - 1,0 - 2,0 - 3,0. Side connectors on edges 0,0|1,0 (pair A internal), 2,0|3,0 (pair B internal), and 1,0|2,0 (joining the two pairs). No other connectors/joints between pairs. Verified by get_build counts: 4 pieces + 3 connectors.

finish.summary: Built four bases in a row forming two pairs (0,0+1,0 and 2,0+3,0) with side-connector-double within each pair and between the pairs, satisfying the inter-pair-only side-connector topology. House rules capped and locked.

lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
